concept: Foundation of the Indian National Congress
question: Who among the following was one of the founders of the Indian National Congress in 1885?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Allan Octavian Hume**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Allan Octavian Hume** was a British civil servant, political reformer, and one of the founders of the Indian National Congress (INC) in 1885.
 
• Hume played a pivotal role in establishing the INC along with other prominent leaders such as Dadabhai Naoroji and Dinshaw Wacha.
